title: 1960s patent for nuclear-powered tunneling device and underground connectors
place_text: Nellis/Area 51, Edwards, Dugway, Washington D.C. to Virginia mountains

tellings.quote: in our archive we have the actual 1960s patent for a nuclearpowered tunnely device

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who pushes for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says his archive holds a real 1960s patent for a nuclear-powered tunneling machine. He links it to Bechtel, a large engineering company, and to underground tunnels he says connect secret sites such as Area 51 in Nevada, other military test bases in the West, and Washington, D.C. to the Virginia mountains. If true, it would point to a hidden network of underground facilities.
